visual_tone: clean lifestyle B-roll, natural light, documentary feel — real places and people, not stock clichés
camera_style: stable for A-roll; for B-roll use quick push-ins, handheld tracking, and over-shoulder shots
mood: clear, grounded, emotionally honest without being harsh
color_palette: natural daylight, muted neutrals, soft contrast
avoid: harsh lighting, text overlays, logos, stock-photo feel, generic abstract light patterns as default
format: vertical 9:16, must look like real video not a photograph, continuous but not floaty motion throughout
filler_clip: Soft morning light across a quiet desk with a notebook and ceramic cup. Camera: gentle overhead push-in. No people, no text.
